tb21_profile.skill: Apply domain rules (Golden Gate / BsaI cut-site requirements) to design DNA primers under simultaneous numeric constraints (length 15-45, Tm 58-72, pair delta<=5) verified by an external CLI oracle, doing reverse-complement and junction/overhang reasoning
tb21_profile.domain: Molecular biology / synthetic biology: FASTA sequences, PCR primers, type-IIS restriction cloning, primer3 oligotm thermodynamics
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec / design-artifact-satisfying-a-rule-set, with an exact output file format and an external ground-truth tool

searches: tools.py search all "golden gate|BsaI|restriction enzyme|restriction site|plasmid|ligation|overhang"
tools.py search all "primer3|oligotm|melting temperature|Tm of|reverse complement"
tools.py search smith "alignment|Levenshtein|edit distance|longest common subsequence|similarity|reverse the|string2string|textdistance"
tools.py search smith "temperature|melting|constraint|within the range|minimum number"
tools.py words rts spec constraint "must satisfy" validator format

Selects PCR primers from aligned genomes, reverse-complementing the reverse primer; same primer-placement and strand-orientation reasoning.

notes: TMax-15K is by far the strongest pool: it contains dozens of genuine primer-design/Tm tasks. TerminalWorld has real bioinformatics CLI seeds (BLAST+, wgsim, gt, refgenie) which transfer on the drive-a-domain-tool-with-exact-flags axis. SWE-Smith has zero biology (119 repos, none bioinformatics) so its 10 are honest 1-2s chosen for sequence-algorithm and strict-encoding skill only. SWE-Rebench has exactly three cogent3 tasks and nothing else biological; ranks 4-10 there are scientific/constraint-optimisation stand-ins and should be treated as filler. Recursive-Task-Synthesis bio content is limited to wgsim/refgenie/VCF chores; ranks 5-10 are filler on task_form similarity only.
